summary: Align the bundled Ghost Ship seed version with the module release and bump the Forge-distributed module to 0.2.1.

checks.name: Manifest parses at 0.2.1
checks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.2.1') throw new Error('expected module 0.2.1');"

checks.name: Seed and module release versions agree
checks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); if(!s.includes('const MODULE_VERSION = \"0.2.1\";')) throw new Error('Ghost Ship seed version mismatch');"
